appDescription: Finds personalized stops along the current navigation route and adds the chosen one as a waypoint.

function.name: FIND_STOPS_ON_ROUTE
function.description: Search places along the current route and recommend up to three that fit the user's request and personal history, ranked by fit and added travel time.

userRequest.description: The user's request about where to stop, kept in the user's original language.

maxDetourMinutes.description: The largest extra travel time in minutes the user accepts, when the user states one.

function.name: ADD_STOP_TO_ROUTE
function.description: Add one of the recommended places to the current route as a waypoint.

rank.description: The position of the chosen place in the latest recommendation list, starting from 1.
